provenance.author: this repository
provenance.method: pivot search over the 30 single-ququint stabilizer states, then exact refit with fit_coeffs.fit

notes: |T5> = 5^(-1/2) sum_x w5^(x^3) |x> is a combination of |0>, |1> and the full-support state 5^(-1/2) sum_y w5^(4y^2 + 4y) |y>, with the coefficients above recovered exactly by fit_coeffs.fit from the normal equations and the identity checked symbolically by the verifier. The pivot search lists five rank-3 decompositions over the 30 single-ququint states in all. With the exact rank-2 exclusion of cert_t5_m1_rank2.py this settles chi(|T5>) = 3, which is below the local dimension, unlike T3 where chi(|T3>) = 3 = p. The implied gamma log_5(3) = 0.6826 is the single-copy product bound; no exponent has been published for any p = 5 state, so it is the baseline the orbit is measured against.
